overall_reason: A large Tailwind v4 and shadcn token set exists, but the theme is built by pairing value-named tokens per component (bg-light-bg dark:bg-dark-bg) with literal dark overrides, and the chrome adds bracketed near-black backgrounds.

score.reason: T-THEME-PARITY fails on a theme made of per-component pairs and literal dark rules (TOK-009), T-HARDCODE on bracketed hex backgrounds (TOK-006) and T-TOKEN-TIERS on value-named theme tokens (TOK-007); radius and spacing pass.

findings.where: .dark block and component classes (stylesheet); whole page at 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: Components carry both modes as class pairs (div.bg-light-bg.dark:bg-dark-bg; text-light-muted) on tokens named --color-light-bg, --color-dark-bg, --color-light-text and --color-dark-text. The .dark block (39 declarations) redefines 49% of semantic colours (semantic_colour_not_redefined includes --color-background, --color-foreground, --color-primary, --color-card) and sets 45 literal colours in dark rules, for example .dark .btn-secondary rgb(248,250,252) and rgba(255,255,255,0.05).
findings.before: A theme built from per-component light/dark pairs and literal overrides
findings.after: One set of role names (--surface, --text, --muted, --border) redefined under .dark; components read the role once
findings.why: Every new component needs two classes per colour, and the literal overrides do not follow token changes.

findings.where: code blocks, demo frames and chrome panels; 1440 (tiles/1440-00.png, tiles/1440-04.png)
findings.evidence: declarations.arbitrary_value_selectors includes .bg-[#0A0E27], .bg-[#0D0D1A], .bg-[#0D1117], .bg-[#1A1A2E] (also as .bg-[#1a1a2e]), .bg-[#1e1e2e], .border-[rgba(0,0,0,0.1)], .rounded-[32px], [36px] and [40px]; literal_retypes_a_token_value: colour 16, spacing 8, radius 5. tokens.undeclared_references.without_fallback includes --bg (16 uses), --color-bg (11), --color-secondary (10) and --cta (9).
findings.before: Five near-black backgrounds as bracketed hex; references to tokens no readable sheet declares
findings.after: One dark surface token for code and panels; the undeclared names either declared or replaced
findings.why: Five near-blacks for one job is drift, and a missing token renders as nothing.

findings.evidence: tokens.naming_samples show value-named theme tokens (--color-light-bg, --color-dark-card, --color-primary-dark, --color-primary-light) beside shadcn roles (--card and --color-card both declared). 135 tokens guess as primitive and 61 as semantic.
findings.before: Theme tokens named by the mode and lightness they hold
findings.after: Role names, with the mode carried by the theme block
findings.why: Names tied to a value force a rename when the value changes.

findings.where: headings and fills in the chrome; 1440
findings.evidence: values.1440.colour_text.near_duplicates pairs #f8fafc (74) and #ffffff (18) on heading text; colour_fill pairs #0080ff and #2b7fff, and #00bc7d and #10b981.
findings.before: Two whites for heading text; two blues and two greens a hair apart
findings.after: One heading text role; one value per accent
findings.why: The pairs do one job each.

strengths: Radii on tokens (on_token 1.0): pills, 16px cards and 8px controls.
Spacing is 95% var() on a 4px base.
not_investigated: The demo previews (code samples, the PawSpa result page) are exhibits with their own palettes; the table did not separate them and they were not judged as the page's components.
The undeclared references may be set by inline styles on the demo previews; not confirmed.
The light theme was read from the stylesheet only; the capture renders dark.
23 requests were blocked by the capture network.
Visitor mode inferred as Persuade (a design-skill product page); no contract.
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no contract and no supplied design system or token file, so drift from a system could not be judged.
Inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles, not which rule or inline style set a value.
Token source files (Sass, JSON token files, Figma variables) behind the shipped CSS were not available.
States the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus, dialogs): their values were not in the table.
